subject: Affordable Housing Trust Ordinance
overview: The committee discussed and advanced a draft ordinance to establish an affordable housing trust, debating labor standards and the extent of council oversight on property sales.

items.title: Establishment of an Affordable Housing Trust (20-024)
items.summary: The committee debated whether to mandate prevailing wage rates for all trust-funded projects or adopt a preference for project labor agreements to maintain development viability. Approved an amendment requiring City Council approval for the trust to convey any real property exceeding 7,500 square feet. Referred the ordinance out of committee with recommendations for flexible trustee stipends and labor agreement preferences. Approved a motion to request formal feedback on the draft from the Greater Boston Building Trades Unions.
